summary.en: Synthetic training skill at the fictional Harbour Island ferry office. It contains no clinical content and exists only to test the skills software.
summary.ar: مهارة تدريبية تجريبية في مكتب عبّارات جزيرة الميناء الخيالي. لا تحتوي على أي محتوى سريري وهي موجودة فقط لاختبار برنامج المهارات.

en: Describe when the fictional scanner is set up.
Complete the fictional set-up checklist in order.
Say who to tell when the scanner will not start.
ar: صف متى يتم تجهيز الماسح الخيالي.
اذكر لمن تُبلّغ عندما لا يعمل الماسح.

en: Read the fictional office handbook, section 1.
ar: اقرأ دليل المكتب الخيالي، القسم الأول.

en: The scanner is set up before the first departure of the day.
ar: يُجهَّز الماسح قبل أول رحلة في اليوم.

en: Keep the fictional power lead away from the ticket desk edge.
Do not open the scanner case while it is plugged in.
ar: أبعد سلك الطاقة الخيالي عن حافة مكتب التذاكر.
لا تفتح غلاف الماسح وهو موصول بالكهرباء.

en: The duty assistant sets up the scanner; the harbour manager decides whether to delay boarding.
Scanner, power lead and a sheet of test tickets (all fictional).
Wash hands and clear the desk.
Plug in, switch on, scan one test ticket, read the result.
Re-scan a test ticket after each reboot.
If the scanner does not start after two attempts, tell the harbour manager.
ar: إذا لم يعمل الماسح بعد محاولتين، أبلغ مدير الميناء.

en: Write the time and result in the fictional daily log.
ar: اكتب الوقت والنتيجة في السجل اليومي الخيالي.

en: Tell the next shift if the scanner needed a reboot.

text.en: Clear the desk and check the power lead is undamaged.
text.ar: امسح المكتب وتأكد من سلامة سلك الطاقة.

text.en: Confirm the scanner case is closed.
Plug in and switch on the scanner.
Scan one test ticket and read the result aloud.
text.ar: امسح تذكرة اختبار واحدة واقرأ النتيجة بصوت عالٍ.

text.en: Re-scan a test ticket after any reboot.
Tell the harbour manager if the scanner fails twice.
text.ar: أبلغ مدير الميناء إذا فشل الماسح مرتين.

text.en: Record time and result in the daily log.
text.ar: سجّل الوقت والنتيجة في السجل اليومي.

summary.en: Synthetic training skill: read a fictional weather board and report it. No clinical content; used only to test checklists and progress.
summary.ar: مهارة تدريبية تجريبية: قراءة لوحة طقس خيالية والإبلاغ عنها. لا محتوى سريري.

en: Read each field of the fictional board.
Report a value that is outside the fictional safe range.
ar: اقرأ كل حقل في اللوحة الخيالية.
أبلغ عن قيمة خارج النطاق الآمن الخيالي.

en: Read the board at the start of every shift.
ar: اقرأ اللوحة في بداية كل مناوبة.

en: Never edit the board without the harbour manager.
Compare each reading with the fictional safe range on the handbook card.
Report an out-of-range reading to the harbour manager straight away.
Copy readings to the daily log exactly as shown.

text.en: Find the handbook card with the safe ranges.
Read wind, tide and visibility from the board.
Compare each value with the safe range.
Report any out-of-range value to the manager immediately.
Copy the readings into the daily log.

summary.en: Synthetic training skill about moving a fictional luggage trolley across the ferry ramp. Contains no clinical content.

en: Check the ramp before moving the trolley.
Use a second person for loads over the fictional limit.
Complete the fictional manual-handling briefing.
Whenever the trolley must cross the ramp.
Brake on before loading.
Never push the trolley downhill alone.
Luggage trolley and two safety cones (fictional).
Place cones, release the brake, move in a straight line, brake on.
If the ramp is wet, stop and tell the harbour manager.
Log any near miss in the fictional safety book.

text.en: Check the ramp is dry and clear.
Place the two safety cones.
Release the brake and move in a straight line.
Apply the brake at the top of the ramp.
Log any near miss in the safety book.

summary.en: Synthetic training skill: set up and test a fictional harbour radio. No clinical content; it exercises search, filters and bookmarks.

en: Test the fictional radio channel.
Use the fictional call-sign format.
At the start of each shift.
Keep the aerial away from the fictional rain shield.
Charge the radio the night before.
Switch on, set channel 3, say the call sign, wait for a reply.
If there is no reply after two calls, tell the harbour manager.
Record the test time in the daily log.

text.en: Check the radio is charged.
Switch on and select channel 3.
Say the call sign clearly and wait for a reply.
If there is no reply after two calls, tell the manager.
Record the test time in the daily log.
